title: Direct native JSON Schema check sites agree between source and N47 catalog
question: Which current installed routines contain the direct native JSON Schema check and do generated declarations show the same sites?
method: Render the typed target routine declarations and independently read the stage pg_proc bodies. Compare routine names and literal schema-qualified calls.

outputs.role: Actual matched population, counts and source ownership

conclusion: All 43 qualified routines containing the selected native function agree with their generated declarations at 54 explicit call sites. The inventory supplies precise ownership for subsequent retirement decisions.
